item.name: API to Fulfill Upsell Offers to customers and third parties
Post Upsell Offers for a reservation

request.name: Post Upsell Offers for a reservation

description.content:
This API allows user to update a reservation by fulfilling an upsell offer selected from the list of available upsell offers, based on the unique offer ID provided in the request body. If an upsell offer group has `selectionType` set to `zero_to_one`, the user can choose only one offer under a specific `offerType` group. To process multiple offers, submit a API request for a `offer` selected If an upsell offer group has `selectionType` set to `zero_to_many`, the user can choose multiple offers under a specific `offerType` group. To process multiple offers, submit a separate API request for each `offer` selected

OperationId: postUpsellOffers

description.content:
An upsell service that can be consumed to display upgrade offers to a hotel guest prior to arrival. Pre-arrival upsells are becoming increasingly important due to the adoption of mobile and kiosk check-in which reduces the opportunity for front-desk upselling. Upgrade offers are based on PRiME(R) AI/ML decision intelligence and OPERA real-time inventory. The service allows instant fulfillment of the upgrade offer.

Compatible with OPERA Cloud release 26.2.0.0.
